description: React component for displaying and editing a code snippet / snippet detail view, including interactions such as updating, deleting, sharing, and copying a link.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving updated snippet data to the backend, manages loading state, and catches errors.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Confirms deletion, deletes snippet via API, and navigates away; handles errors.

methods.name: onToggleShare
methods.description: Toggles snippet privacy status (public/private) via API, updates local state, and handles errors.

methods.name: copyLink
methods.description: Copies snippet share link to clipboard and shows alert.

methods.name: SnippetDetail({ id, navigate, user, onSignInClick, onSignOut })

ctags.name: SnippetDetail
ctags.pattern: /^export function SnippetDetail({ id, navigate, user, onSignInClick, onSignOut }) {$/
